text: 知情人士称，Blue Owl Capital寻求设立一家数据中心房地产投资信托基金(REIT)，并推动其上市。随着越来越多公司进入资本市场，为人工智能基础设施建设筹集资金，数据中心相关资产正成为新的融资热点。一名因信息未公开而不愿具名的知情人士称，这家另类资产管理公司预计将向该REIT注入约65亿美元自有数据中心资产，作为启动资产。据悉Blue Owl计划通过首次公开募股及后续增发股份筹集资金，用于收购更多数据中心并扩大资产组合。Blue Owl目前拥有一系列数据中心资产，并于5月完成旗下最新一只数字基础设施基金的募集，获得70亿美元资金承诺。知情人士称
text_en: Sources say Blue Owl Capital is seeking to set up a data center real estate investment trust (REIT) and take it public. As more companies enter capital markets to raise funds for AI infrastructure, data center-related assets are becoming a new financing hotspot. One source, who spoke anonymously as the information is not public, said the alternative asset manager expects to inject about $6.5 billion of its own data center assets into the REIT as seed capital. Blue Owl plans to raise funds through an IPO and subsequent share issuance to acquire more data centers and expand the portfolio.
